      "observations": [
        "All 315 owned diff lines across four paths were read, including the complete new 58-line fixture, 174-line test and manifest entry. The parser replaces requestedLocale substring/zero-key fallback with requestedLocales lookup negotiation. Name and description use independent available-key arrays, each with en if present or its first key as fallback. Existing shared locale knowledge is reused rather than duplicated.",
        "The actual receiver returns the same config immediately when no incoming alternative has type exchange. Otherwise it fetches the configured JSON with the supplied abort signal, parses entries, picks a supported type matching the available endpoint, throws if none match, and assigns config.addons. Existing HTTPS XPI validation and per-entry error isolation are not introduced by this locale patch.",
        "Five new tasks use seven assertions with explicit nonempty messages: no-Exchange object identity and no addons field, full matching add-on structures, empty-URL rejection, no-matching-addon rejection with absent addons, and exact abort-error identity. The normal locale is en-US; the unusual single-key map exercises first-key fallback. Other locale sequences, differing name/description key sets, empty maps and malformed data are not directly covered by this fixture. No network or test was run.",
        "The first strictEqual message says It should modify the config that was passed in, but its no-Exchange path returns the original object without adding addons. The assertion checks identity, not mutation. The separate addons-undefined assertion matches that path; a future wording change should state the actual return/identity expectation rather than claim modification.",
        "The test explicitly clears its add-on URL preference and restores requestedLocales after the normal-case deep assertion. Its using server resource invokes only the server disposer on scope exit; the disposer does not perform those global-setting restorations and its stop result is not awaited here. Failure before the explicit restoration lines skips those local actions. This is a bounded test-body cleanup limit, not a claim about all outer harness cleanup or an executed leak.",
        "Accepted fixture bytes are identical to the owned blob. The accepted test differs only by removal of its first modeline; the test body and seven assertion sites remain exact. Later production edits outside the selected fetch/locale contracts are not treated as part of this patch.",
        "The complete primary 2011846 preserves the en-CA report and EN-US non-reproduction, followed by the explicit negotiation/mock-test proposal. Exact source adopts that proposal. Screenshots, Matrix discussion, public add-on JSON and related D285808 remain unread locators. Full D290194 has no actual inlines or histories; acceptance precedes an add missing using update, which the owned source includes. Historical remote completion is not a fresh locale, platform, install or server-cleanup result.",
        "The source-only pending marker is resolved by complete primary 2011846 current comments 0–9 and own D290194 creation-to-final timeline, including its later related-revision mention. The explicit primary proposal is reconciled against actual source; the add missing using update after acceptance appears in the owned tests.
